protocol.significant_improvement: Training cross-entropy decrease greater than max(0.0001, 0.001 * last significant best loss)
protocol.scope: Fresh full-data training for all 13 tabular datasets, five methods, three paired seeds; no source prefixes, no row subsampling or split-size caps.
protocol.initialization: Fresh models; no cancelled benchmark checkpoint or historical metrics are resumed.
protocol.split_rule: Same partition rules as the prior experiment before its caps: official train/validation/test retained where provided; otherwise 20% of official train for validation; single-source datasets split 60/20/20. Stratification when class counts permit.
protocol.minimum_updates_rule: max(2000, ceil(number of training rows including configured repeats / 128)); at least one entire shuffled pass precedes stopping or plateau LR reductions.
protocol.stop: 100% training accuracy and CE <= 0.01, or training-loss plateau after at least three LR reductions. Only full training metrics control stopping. No maximum updates/epochs/time.
protocol.selection: Minimum full-training-set cross-entropy, with full model and matching optimizer restored before final held-out test evaluation.
protocol.checkpoint: Resumable model, optimizer, controller, paired minibatch RNG/order/cursor, CPU/CUDA/noise RNG and curves; every 100 updates to SSD, durable backup every 300s and at completion.
protocol.population_backend: Verified batched iid full-model Gaussian estimator; direct CUDA RNG from first update. Same estimator and noise distribution as production; different RNG stream from sequential implementation.

numerical_recovery.policy: Restore minimum finite training-loss model and matching optimizer, lower learning rate, log event. Exceeding limit is a failed run, never convergence.

protocol.initial_learning_rates: Adam repository per-dataset learning rate; population 0.01.
protocol.training_batch_policy: Carry the final remainder into the next shuffled pass; no training rows are dropped.
protocol.timing_note: Concurrent GPU jobs; durations are not controlled isolated performance comparisons.
protocol.target_caveat: Blog Feedback retains the repository count-as-classification task; this is not a regression benchmark.
protocol.validation_policy: Full validation metrics logged at training evaluations but never control training or selection; full test metrics evaluated only after stopping.
